co2_reference.note: NASA OCHMO reference; not applied here as autonomous clinical severity rule

parameter_note: Terrestrial pulse/BP profiles, day-to-day distributions and correlation coefficients are illustrative chosen model parameters, not fitted to raw NHANES or astronaut individual data. NASA sleep aggregate and CO2 guidance are external checks, not a validated simulation. CO2 is correlated with demo symptoms by construction, not causal proof.

replay_policy.rule: Models and UI must only see observations at or before current simulated clock; evaluation event labels NEVER supplied to live app

references.title: Astronaut Sleep Duration Varies by Timing of Scheduled Sleep
references.use: Published in-flight mean 7.33h, SD 1.16h for sample (n=19; 2137 nights), only a population-level check

references.title: OCHMO-TB-004 Carbon Dioxide
references.use: NASA-reported cabin CO2 monitoring framework, exposure standards and uncertainty of headache association; no probability fit

references.title: Spaceflight Standard Measures
references.use: Instrument, check-in and observation-category selection; not numeric distributions

references.title: NHANES 2017-2018 BPX_J blood pressure and pulse metadata
references.use: Terrestrial measurement definitions/protocol and observed ranges; public XPT rows were not downloaded and model not statistically fit to NHANES
